polaris: LP29-C2T-S2 / context baseline vs reproduced Srivastava exact O_s baseline
framework: Round 3 converts the A-side field-level blocker table into an executor-facing reproduction-attempt row contract. The contract fixes four admissible modes: reported_context_only, fixed_density_attempt, fixed_pair_attempt, and exact_reproduction_attempt. Each Srivastava sample row is allowed to pass only in reported_context_only mode; all reproduction or alternative-comparison modes are blocked until their explicit witnesses exist.

findings.summary: The blocker table has been normalized into a 16-row contract: four Srivastava samples times four attempt modes. Reported context is available for all four samples. fixed_density_attempt, fixed_pair_attempt, and exact_reproduction_attempt are blocked for every sample because the needed witnesses remain absent. No material validation, residual validation, or graph-beats-overlap claim is enabled.

attempt_modes.reported_context_only: PASS_REPORTED_CONTEXT_ONLY for all four rows; use only reported OI_norm, cell volume, m_eff, and method labels as literature context.
attempt_modes.fixed_density_attempt: BLOCK_FIXED_DENSITY_ATTEMPT for all four rows; pair_density, pair_density provenance, structure identity, atom count, raw overlap sum, and normalization binding are missing.
attempt_modes.fixed_pair_attempt: BLOCK_FIXED_PAIR_ATTEMPT for all four rows; N_pair, pair-list provenance, structure identity, atom count, raw overlap sum, and OI_pair_mean are missing.
attempt_modes.exact_reproduction_attempt: BLOCK_EXACT_REPRODUCTION_ATTEMPT for all four rows; the complete Srivastava witness package is missing.

allowed_use_now: Use all four Srivastava rows as reported_context_only.
Use reported OI_norm, cell volume, m_eff_over_m0, DOI, source_row_id, pair_cutoff_A, and method labels as context descriptors.
Use the attempt contract as an executor gate that should return PASS only for reported_context_only mode.
forbidden_use_now: Do not label reported OI_norm as reproduced exact O_s.
Do not run or report material residual validation from these rows.
Do not claim graph metrics beat the orbital-overlap baseline.
Do not infer pair_density, N_pair, OI_pair_mean, OI_raw_sum, or normalization witnesses from reported OI_norm.
Do not use core_38590358.pdf or DOI 10.1038/srep13467 as Srivastava evidence.

weakest_link: The weakest link is still row-level executable provenance. The new contract makes the failure local and machine-checkable: every non-context mode requires witnesses that the current A-side payload does not contain, especially exact structure identity, pair-list provenance, N_pair, OI_raw_sum, executable normalization, and same-structure mapping.

next_plan.immediate: Feed the attempt contract to INSPECTOR A Round 3. The expected inspector result should verify fixed enum statuses, explicit mode branches, four-sample coverage, and preservation of the no-material-validation boundary.
next_plan.executor_rule: A reproduction executor should accept only rows with expected_reproduction_status=PASS_REPORTED_CONTEXT_ONLY for context display. It should reject fixed_density_attempt, fixed_pair_attempt, and exact_reproduction_attempt unless the listed witnesses are attached with provenance ids.
next_plan.unblock_path: Recover official PDF/SI row provenance, Srivastava structures or coordinate hashes, pair-list generation code/output, N_pair provenance, raw overlap sums, executable Mulliken/STO kernel, q_i_q_j weights, normalization formula id, reproduced OI_norm checks, and same-structure mappings.
next_plan.fallback_if_witnesses_remain_missing: Keep Srivastava rows in reported_context_only mode. Any future fixed_density or fixed_pair baseline must be declared as a separate non-Srivastava comparison mode and cannot inherit the Srivastava reproduction label.

resolved_previous_warnings.keep_OI_norm_reported_context_only: resolved: contract passes only reported_context_only and blocks all reproduction modes.
resolved_previous_warnings.do_not_use_wrong_fallback_pdf: resolved: forbidden_use_now keeps core_38590358.pdf and DOI 10.1038/srep13467 excluded.
resolved_previous_warnings.do_not_advance_to_material_validation: resolved: all rows forbid residual or graph validation; no residual fields are populated.
resolved_previous_warnings.preserve_decisive_claim_allowed_false: resolved: contract allows context display only and provides no decisive material claim.
resolved_previous_warnings.normalize_to_fixed_mode_branches: resolved_for_A: mode labels and expected statuses are fixed strings suitable for executor gating.

deepening_1.layer_1: Field-level blockers are insufficient for execution because they identify missing evidence globally but do not say what an executor should do for a specific row and mode.
deepening_1.layer_2: The row contract resolves this by making the admissible action row-local: reported_context_only passes as context, while fixed_density_attempt, fixed_pair_attempt, and exact_reproduction_attempt fail with explicit missing-witness lists.

deepening_2.layer_1: The most dangerous false upgrade path is to treat reported OI_norm as if it supplies either OI_raw_sum or a normalized exact O_s witness.
deepening_2.layer_2: The contract blocks that upgrade by requiring independent raw sums, pair provenance, executable normalization, and same-structure mapping before any non-context status can pass.
